newsitem.title: USA: General Parcel names new president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: General Parcel names new president, CEO.

text.p: General Parcel Service Inc said Monday it had named Philip Belyew as president and chief executive, effective January 6.
Belyew succeeds E. Hoke Smith, the company's founder, who resigned for medical reasons, the company said.
Most recently, Belyew was chairman, president and chief executive of United TransNet Inc UT.N.
General Parcel provides shipping and delivery services for small packages on a one- or two-day basis among the states of Florida, Georgia, North Carolina and South Carolina.
